instruction: Suppose the orange cone is rotated by 22 degrees about the vertical axis (the image's up-down direction) through its center, so that the side facing the camera moves to the right. Give the mask of the orange cone after the rotation.

Rotate the purple triangular prism in your mind by 51 degrees about the vertical axis (the image's up-down direction) passing through its center, so that the side facing the camera moves to the right. Where does the purple triangular prism appear now?
The camera moves 0.12 m backward along its line of sight, without turning. Give the mask of the green torus as seen from the new camera position.
The camera moves 0.36 m backward along its line of sight, without turning. Where is the green torus in the new view?
Give the full (amodal) mask of the teal circle, as if nothing were in front of it.
Segment the entire green cross, including the parts covered by other objects.
The purple circle is released from rest. Show where the purple circle will be after 5 steps of 1/30 second each.

The purple circle moves to the right at 0.30 image widths per second and the brown-and-black striped rectangle moves to the left at 0.65 image widths per second, toward each other. After 10 steps (1/30 s per step), which pixels will the brown-and-black striped rectangle occupy?
